item.title: Eventbrite Adds Autocomplete to Search Events
item.description:
Eventbrite Adds Autocomplete to Search Events

Eventbrite introduced an autocomplete capability for its Search events function.

🔍 Overview

  • New autocomplete appears in the Search events workflow.

🛠️ Features

  • Search events
  • autocomplete
  • Find my tickets
  • Sign in
  • Find Events
  • Create Events
  • Solutions
  • Event Ticketing
  • Event Marketing Platform
  • Eventbrite Ads
  • Payments

📂 Supported Industries

  • Music
  • Food & Beverage
  • Performing Arts
  • Charity & Causes
  • Retail

🎫 Event Types

  • Concerts
  • Classes & Workshops
  • Festivals & Fairs
  • Conferences
  • Corporate Events
  • Online Events

🚀 Release

  • Announced at the Oct 8 – MCP/Agents/Skills Meetup, an online event hosted by Voxel51.
  • The meetup took place on Thursday, October 8, 9 AM – 11 AM PDT.
  • Sales ended for the event on Thu, Oct 8, 9 AM PDT.

#Eventbrite #AI #Search #Autocomplete #Events

Source: Oct 8 - MCP/Agents/Skills Meetup
